## Pull request overview

Restructures the `plugin-object` documentation from a single MDX file into a dedicated subdirectory with an overview page and component-specific reference pages, improving navigation and discoverability.

**Changes:**
- Replaced `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object.mdx` with a `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/` directory.
- Added `index.mdx` plus dedicated docs pages for `ObjectTable`, `ObjectForm`, and `ObjectView`.
- Introduced `meta.json` to define sidebar/navigation ordering within the new directory.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 22 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/index.mdx | New plugin overview page linking to component pages; includes install/config/type examples. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-table.mdx | New ObjectTable reference page with demo, examples, and API table. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-form.mdx | New ObjectForm reference page with demo, examples (create/edit), and API table. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-view.mdx | New ObjectView reference page with demo, examples, and API table. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/meta.json | Adds navigation metadata for the new plugin-object subdirectory. |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object.mdx | Removes the prior monolithic plugin-object documentation page. |
</details>

Same issue in the edit-mode JSON example: `onSuccess` is documented as a navigate action object, but `ObjectForm` expects a callback function. As written, this config will not work with the current implementation.

In this TypeScript example, `ObjectTableSchema` doesn’t have `columns: string[]` for selecting which object fields to show. Use `fields?: string[]` for field selection, and reserve `columns?: TableColumn[]` for detailed column configs (with `accessorKey`) per `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`.
```suggestion
  fields: ['name', 'email', 'role'],
```

These “Related Documentation” links appear to be broken in this repo’s docs tree (there is no `/content/docs/ecosystem` or `/content/docs/concepts`). Consider updating them to the existing guide pages (e.g. `/docs/guide/data-source` and `/docs/guide/plugins`) or adding the missing pages.
```suggestion
- [ObjectQL Integration](/docs/guide/data-source)
- [Data Sources](/docs/guide/data-source)
- [Plugin System Overview](/docs/guide/plugins)
```

The documented properties here (`columns`, `filters`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `searchable`) don’t match `ObjectTableSchema` (`fields`, `defaultFilters`, `defaultSort`, `showSearch`, etc.). Align this table with `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` to avoid misleading API docs.

In `customFields`, `FormField.type` should be a renderer field type like `'input'`/`'textarea'`/`'select'` (with `inputType` for HTML input types). Using `type: "text"` isn’t a supported form field type in the renderer (`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`).
```suggestion
        type: "input",
        inputType: "text",
        required: true,
        placeholder: "Enter full name"
      },
      { 
        name: "email", 
        label: "Email Address", 
        type: "input",
        inputType: "email",
```

The Properties table documents `view`, `listColumns`, `detailFields`, `editFields`, and `actions`, but these aren’t part of `ObjectViewSchema`. Align this table with `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` (e.g., `layout`, `table`, `form`, `showSearch`, `showFilters`, `showCreate`, `showRefresh`, `operations`, `onNavigate`).

`ObjectFormSchema` uses `initialValues` for create-mode defaults (not `defaultValues`). Please update this JSON example to `initialValues` to match `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`.
```suggestion
  "initialValues": {
```

`ObjectFormSchema.onSuccess` is a callback function, not an action schema. Showing `onSuccess: { type: 'toast' | 'navigate', ... }` in JSON is misleading because `ObjectForm` will try to call it as a function and fail. Consider documenting success handling as a React callback, or explicitly label this as pseudocode.

`ObjectTableSchema` uses `fields?: string[]` to choose which object fields become columns. `columns` is for `TableColumn[]` configs (with `accessorKey`), so `columns: ['name', ...]` in this snippet won’t do what the docs imply.
`ObjectFormSchema` uses `groups` for grouping fields. `fieldGroups` is not part of the schema (see `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`). Update this example to the supported `groups` structure.

This `object-view` JSON example uses unsupported keys (`view`, `listColumns`, `detailFields`, `editFields`, `actions`). These aren’t part of `ObjectViewSchema` and aren’t consumed by `packages/plugin-object/src/ObjectView.tsx`. Please update the example to the supported shape (e.g., `table: { fields, defaultFilters, ... }`, `form: { fields, ... }`, `layout`, etc.).

`ObjectViewSchema` doesn’t support `view`/`listColumns` (the current API uses `layout`, `table`, `form`, and `operations` per `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`). Update this example to match the actual schema so readers can copy/paste it successfully.
```suggestion
  layout: 'table',
  table: {
    columns: ['name', 'price', 'stock'],
  },
```

The Properties table doesn’t match `ObjectFormSchema`: `mode` also supports `'view'`, there is no `defaultValues` field, and `onSuccess`/`onCancel` are callbacks (not `Action`). Align this table with `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`.
```suggestion
| `mode` | 'create' \| 'edit' \| 'view' | Required | Form mode |
| `recordId` | string | - | Record ID for edit mode |
| `fields` | string[] | All fields | Fields to display |
| `layout` | 'vertical' \| 'horizontal' | `'vertical'` | Form layout |
| `onSuccess` | `(result: any) => void` | - | Callback on successful submit |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | - | Callback on cancel |
```

`fieldVisibility` is not part of `ObjectFormSchema`. Conditional rendering is modeled per-field via `FormField.condition` (see `packages/types/src/form.ts`) and implemented in the form renderer. Please update this example to use `condition` on the relevant field(s).
```suggestion
  "fields": [
    "name",
    "type",
    "price",
    {
      "name": "subscription_interval",
      "condition": "${data.type === 'subscription'}"
    }
  ]
```

`ObjectTableSchema` uses `defaultFilters` (not `filters`) for the initial query filter (see `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` and `ObjectTable`’s `fetchData` implementation). Update this JSON accordingly.

`ObjectViewSchema` does not support `view`, `listColumns`, `detailFields`, or `editFields`. The current `ObjectView` API is centered around `layout`, `table` (partial `ObjectTableSchema`), `form` (partial `ObjectFormSchema`), and `operations` (see `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`). Update this Basic Usage snippet to match the real schema.
`ObjectTableSchema` uses `defaultSort: { field, order }` rather than `sortBy`/`sortOrder` (see `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`). The current JSON keys won’t be applied by `ObjectTable`.
